name: Robert Harrison
bio:
Robert Harrison's career began in general human resources, but his lifelong passion for motorsport led him to seek a role where he could combine his professional skills with his personal interests. He joined Mitsubishi Motorsport five years ago, initially as a generalist, but quickly gravitated towards talent acquisition and development specifically for the racing teams. 

Robert's approach to HR is deeply rooted in understanding the unique demands of a high-pressure racing environment. He believes in fostering a culture of continuous improvement and collaboration, ensuring that every team member, from engineers to drivers, has the resources and support they need to excel. His understanding of the technical aspects of motorsport, though not expert-level, allows him to better identify and recruit top talent. What truly sets Robert apart is his ability to connect with people on a personal level, creating a supportive and motivating atmosphere within the team.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Robert is a man of average height with a slightly stocky build.

quirks: Always has a detailed spreadsheet of employee morale metrics.
Starts every meeting with a motorsport-related trivia question.
Secretly practices mindfulness techniques to manage stress.
